name: Anluohuaxian pill (Chinese herbal formula)
short: One placebo-controlled trial (270 people with chronic hepatitis B, 48 weeks): no serious side effects on the pill. The abstract gives no figures on milder side effects or for placebo.
text: Safety evidence for the Anluohuaxian pill comes from one trial abstract. In a double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial at 12 hospitals in China, 270 people with chronic hepatitis B, normal or mildly raised liver enzymes (ALT under twice the upper limit of normal) and early liver fibrosis were assigned 2 to 1 to the pill or placebo for 48 weeks; no serious side effects occurred in those taking the pill. The abstract does not report milder side effects, gives no safety figures for the placebo group and does not list the pill's herbs. No interaction data were found in the cited source.

citations.label: Xiao et al., 2022, J Ethnopharmacol
citations.title: Efficacy and safety of AnluoHuaxian pills on chronic hepatitis B with normal or minimally elevated alanine transaminase and early liver fibrosis: A randomized controlled trial.
